regions.finding: Bibliography and cited prior work only. Reaction names in article titles are not current-paper experiments and no reaction records were created from them.
The paper refers preparation details to Supporting Information, but no SI was supplied or explicitly associated; no procedure was inferred.

Current-paper clarification: the N-tosyl N,O-aminals obtained from 1b and 1l were used directly for alkynylation without isolation after basic workup; instability is stated for the 1b-derived aminal and an isomeric mixture for the 1l-derived aminal. This evidence was merged into the existing 4ba and product-6 records, not counted as new experiments.
Computational level, conformational terminology and alkynylzinc-aggregation limitations. These are calculation/method and mechanistic discussion, not additional observed reactions.
No chemical content in the blank right column; footer contains journal, DOI and printed page metadata only.
